evidence.label: Illustrative reconstruction (spike)
evidence.summary: Generic stand-in room built from primitives and two CC0 props. Not a depiction of any real place or period.

pano.convention: yaw 0 = image centre = north (-Z); yaw +90 deg = east (+X); pitch +90 = up

hotspots.label: Basket on a post, north end
hotspots.description: A wicker basket fixed to a wooden post at the north end of the room, about three metres above the floor. It is a generic CC0 prop used as a stand-in; it does not depict any real object.

hotspots.label: Standing chalkboard
hotspots.description: A free-standing chalkboard on the north-east side of the floor, turned toward the viewer. It is a CC0 3D model placed as a stand-in and carries no text.

hotspots.label: Running track balcony
hotspots.description: A raised walkway runs around the room above head height, with a wooden rail and balusters. From the floor you see the rail and the underside; the walking surface is out of sight. Generic construction, not measured from any real building.

hotspots.label: Tall windows, east wall
hotspots.description: A row of tall windows in the east wall, above the balcony rail. They supply the daylight in the picture.

a11y.alt: Illustrative reconstruction (spike): a generic gymnasium-like room seen from its centre, with a wooden floor, a raised running-track balcony, two basket-and-post stations at the north and south ends, tall windows, and chalkboards.
a11y.longDescription: The room is a generic stand-in. A wooden floor with painted court lines fills the centre. A raised balcony with a wooden rail and balusters runs around all four sides. At the north end a wicker basket is fixed to a post; at the south end a hoop with a net is fixed to a second post. A standing chalkboard sits on the north-east side. Tall windows line the east and west walls above the balcony. A small calibration panel (the letter N), a red cube and a yellow disc are test markers used to check the image is not mirrored; they are not part of any real room.
